blocks.md: This lesson follows **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** in *The Agent Harness* (Vol III).

blocks.source: Vol III, The Agent Harness, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: An agent harness synthesizes classical ideas that operating systems, databases, and computer networks developed when shared infrastructure encountered clients that could not be trusted to self-regulate or terminate. In operating systems, Hoare introduced monitors to provide shared mutable state with a single serialized entry point. In reactive systems, Harel formalized statecharts with guarded transitions so that valid controller behavior could be rigorously defined and checked.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Supervision needs one authoritative per-trajectory control record, written only by the harness, holding contract, lifecycle state, accounting, grants, current invocations, the operation table, and a live plan.

A runaway retry loop is locally compliant at every step, so the harness bounds turns, tokens, wall time, and dollars as one vector, reads the largest used fraction, and escalates through steer, restrict, and finalize.

The trajectory advances only along legal state-machine edges whose guards pass on a current record version, and admission commits atomically under the record lock before any request leaves the host (register before send).

A proposal that requires review is held undispatched, bound by digest and expiry, and a favorable decision is one precondition rather than an order, so dispatch re-runs the full admission check and silence expires rather than denies.
